tall.definition: Having a greater height than is usual for the relevant group.

thin.definition: Having a slender body with relatively little body fat.

heavy.definition: Having a relatively large body weight.

athletic.definition: Having a build associated with physical fitness or sport.

blonde.definition: Having pale yellow or golden hair.

brunette.definition: Having brown or dark brown hair.

pigtails.definition: Hair arranged in two bunches or braids, one on each side of the head.

patient.definition: Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming upset.

friendly.definition: Kind and welcoming toward other people.

moody.definition: Having moods that change noticeably or unpredictably.

charismatic.definition: Able to attract and influence others through personal appeal.

calm.definition: Not feeling or showing strong agitation, fear, or anger.

optimistic.definition: Hopeful that things will go well.

confident.definition: Feeling sure of your abilities or decisions.

passionate.definition: Showing strong interest or enthusiasm for something.

grin.definition: A broad smile that shows the teeth.

laugh.definition: To make sounds and facial movements that express amusement.

giggle.definition: To laugh lightly or in short repeated sounds.

wink.definition: To briefly close one eye as a signal.

cry.definition: To shed tears, often because of sadness or pain.

sob.definition: To cry with repeated sharp breaths.

droop.definition: To hang or fall downward, as tired eyelids may do.

gloom.definition: A feeling or expression of sadness.

glare.definition: An intense angry or disapproving look.

stare.definition: To look steadily at someone or something for a long time.

squint.definition: To partly close the eyes when trying to see or reacting to bright light.

startle.definition: To react suddenly because of surprise or alarm.

frozen.definition: Unable to move or react for a moment because of shock or fear.

blister.definition: A small pocket of fluid that forms beneath the surface of the skin.

wrinkles.definition: Lines or folds in the skin.

serum.definition: A lightweight skin-care or hair-care product containing concentrated ingredients.

mousse.definition: A foamy styling product applied to hair.

brush.definition: A tool with bristles used to arrange or untangle hair.

cleanser.definition: A skin-care product used to remove dirt, oil, or makeup.

toner.definition: A liquid skin-care product usually applied after cleansing.

sunscreen.definition: A product applied to skin to help protect it from ultraviolet radiation.

night-cream.definition: A moisturizing cream intended for use on the skin at night.
